Text:
## DIVERTICULITIS
[Oral step-down treatment](orzc-gmenu-abx-step-down-treatment)
## Uncomplicated diverticulitis not requiring admission and not immunocompromised
Antimicrobials not indicated
#Inpatient ## Uncomplicated diverticulitis requiring admission or immunocompromised
Duration of therapy: Treatment duration depends on clinical response, typically
requiring 7-10 days of antimicroibal therapy.
Preferred: [Cefazolin 2 gm IV q8h [R] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV q8h [DI]](orz-set-abx-cefazolin-2gm-iv-q8h-metronidazole-500mg-iv-q8h)
< OR >
[Piperacillin-Tazobactam 3.375g IV q6h [R]](psjizid-pip-taz-3-375-gm-iv-q6h-ne-extinf-ci-cefep-metro)
Alternative:
[Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction](orz-gtx-abx-beta-lactam-reaction-pdf)
[Ciprofloxacin 400 mg IV q12h [R,DI] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV q8h [DI]](orz-set-abx-ciprof-400mg-iv-q12-metron-500mg-iv-q8h)
## Complicated diverticulitis (perforation, abscess, fistula, obstruction) OR meets
## sepsis criteria OR patient is immunocompromised
Consult General Surgery
Duration of therapy: Treatment duration depends on clinical response and source
control, typically requiring 10-14 days of antimicrobial therapy.
Preferred:
[Piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5 gm IV q6h [R]](psjizid-pip-taz-4-5gm-iv-q6h-ne-extinf-ci-cefep-metro)
< OR >
[Meropenem 1 gm IV q8h [R,O]](psjizid-meropenem-1gm-iv-q8h)
Alternative:
Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction
[Ciprofloxacin 400 mg IV q8h [R,DI] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV q8h [DI]](orz-set-abx-ciprofloxacin-400mg-iv-q8h-metro-500mg-iv-q8h)
